name: Subdomain Center (api.subdomain.center)
tier_rationale: Operator not identifiable from public terms or a privacy policy (A8 unknown). Chair decision P016: the extra feeds stay unknown tier until a promotion is recorded.

reliability.justification: Many noisy, user-generated-looking labels: names seen only here stay unconfirmed until they resolve or a second source agrees (P016 cond 7).

subdomains.title: Subdomain Center subdomain list (GET /?domain={domain}, JSON array)

terms.quote: Registry terms per feed (A1 BR3): THC, AnubisDB and Subdomain Center are 'open' (legal_dpo: free services with no published terms, no contractual bar)

subdomains.notes: Quote: binding council text (P016 cond 4). Research C0041: low free limit (a few requests per minute). Live 2026-11-26: first request 503 {"error": "server busy (N queries in flight)"} with Retry-After: 1 (could not verify; the core retries once within the budget), answers take 15-18 s. The optional key of subfinder is not used.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G01-3 (P016, module subdomains_passive_extra). Polite use: 12 s between requests (a few per minute), one request per registrable domain.
